moat_source: technology leadership in datacom optics plus NVIDIA design-in (2B equity stake and multiyear CPO supply agreement); evidence: 41% y/y datacom growth and backlog to 2028, but optics has repeatedly commoditized and FCF is currently negative

returns.assumption_note: Convergence to scenario IV by year 5, ~60% of the gap closed by year 3.

primary_model_risk: FCF emergence timing: TTM FCF is negative with capex at ~70% of operating cash flow; base case assumes ~15% FCF margin by FY2030. If the AI build-out keeps capex elevated (or demand rolls before conversion), the terminal FCF the whole valuation rests on never materializes at modeled scale.
expectations_gap_key_variable: FCF conversion: at $327.59 (~9x run-rate sales on a negative-FCF business) the price assumes both sustained 20%+ revenue growth AND rapid capex normalization; base case credits the growth but staggers the cash conversion
top_5_bull_arguments: NVIDIA's $2B equity stake plus multiyear CPO supply agreement is the strongest possible design-in validation
Datacenter & Communications is 75% of revenue growing 41% y/y with record bookings and backlog visibility to calendar 2028
Q4 FY26 guidance ($1.91-2.05B, EPS $1.52-1.72) implies continued sequential acceleration
1.6T transceiver ramp is margin-accretive per management
$3B cash provides balance-sheet room to fund the capex cycle without distress
top_5_bear_arguments: FCF is negative TTM (-$58M in Q3 alone despite $225M net income) - the market is capitalizing cash flows that do not yet exist
Expected IV ($189) is ~42% below the current price; even the bull case ($353) barely exceeds it
AI-capex concentration: 75% of revenue tied to one spending cycle and largely one ecosystem
Optics history: every prior datacom boom ended in commoditization and margin collapse
Stock fell 7.4% on an earnings beat - positioning is crowded and expectations saturated
thesis_breakers: Datacom revenue growth decelerating below 20% y/y for two consecutive quarters
FCF still negative in FY2027 (capex normalization thesis fails)
NVIDIA CPO agreement descoped, delayed, or dual-sourced away
A major hyperscaler moving transceivers in-house or to a competing supplier
position_size_recommendation: 0% at current price; revisit near expected IV (~$189) or on evidence of positive FCF inflection with growth intact
notes_on_nulls: ROIC/ROE/ROA null: not captured as sourced figures in pass1/claude_pass1 (pass1 is a market snapshot; research pass captured income/cash-flow items only). Revenue and EPS inputs are reported figures; FCF path beyond FY2026 is assumption - confidence_level medium.
